component.name: PosterTile
component.script:
sub onContentChanged() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("name").text = c.title seeds = "" if c.seedText <> invalid then seeds = c.seedText m.top.findNode("seeds").text = seeds
' Assigned unconditionally. A MarkupGrid recycles its item ' components, so skipping the assignment when the new item has no ' poster leaves the PREVIOUS item's artwork on screen -- which reads ' as the wrong cover for the title underneath it. art = "" if c.HDGRIDPOSTERURL <> invalid then art = c.HDGRIDPOSTERURL m.top.findNode("art").uri = art end sub
